Welcome to the official channel for Heartspring! 

You’ll find videos and information regarding our Pediatric Outpatient Clinic, Therapeutic School, and Community Engagement program efforts that feature our experts on pediatric neurodevelopment.  

We provide comprehensive support for children with neurodevelopmental delays and disorders — including speech, hearing or motor development issues, general developmental delays, intellectual and learning challenges, autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, and more. 

Children who receive therapies at Heartspring can build mobility and strength, develop daily living skills, language and communication , improve behaviors and social interactions, and gain greater independence. 

Our interdisciplinary therapies include audiology, applied behavior analysis (ABA), behavioral health, feeding therapy, occupational therapy, physical therapy, and speech-language therapy.
